title: PDFluent Registry SHA Ledger — per-channel
description: Append-only record of every published artifact's sha256, used for indefinite post-publish drift detection. See docs/release/sha_ledger/README.md.

schema_version.description: Ledger schema version. Bump only with a migration.

channel.description: Package channel this ledger covers; matches scripts/release/audit_package_tree.py --channel choices.

package.description: Published package name as it appears in the registry.

version.description: SemVer version string. Pre-release allowed via the standard `-beta.N` / `-rc.N` etc.

artifact_filename.description: Filename of the published artifact as uploaded (e.g. pdfluent-1.0.0-beta.8.crate).

sha256_local.description: sha256 of the locally-built artifact at publish time. Computed by ledger_add_entry.py.

sha256_registry.description: sha256 of the registry-distributed artifact, computed by ledger_verify.py during post-publish verify. Null until verify runs.

size_bytes.description: Byte count of the local artifact.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the publish step. Set by ledger_add_entry.py at write time.

verified_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the post-publish sha256 match. Null until verify_runs.

audit_report.description: Repo-relative path to the prepublish audit report (committed under benchmarks/runs/prepublish_audits/).

verify_report.description: Repo-relative path to the post-publish verify report (committed under benchmarks/runs/post_publish_verify/). Null until verify runs.

status.description: Lifecycle state. live=published+sha_local recorded, verified=sha_registry matches sha_local, yanked=registry yank executed via §13 procedure.

yanked_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the yank action. Null if not yanked.

yanked_reason.description: Short reason for the yank (e.g. 'licence-file missing from tarball'). Required when status=yanked.

registry_url.description: Canonical URL where the artifact can be re-downloaded for verification. e.g. https://static.crates.io/crates/pdfluent/pdfluent-1.0.0-beta.8.crate
